name: pmg-fill-lean-canvas
description: Fills a Lean Canvas for one customer segment (problem, segments, unique value proposition, solution, channels, revenue, costs, key metrics, unfair advantage) with every box marked tested or untested and the three riskiest assumptions named. Use for "run pmg-fill-lean-canvas", "lean canvas", "business model on one page", "new product idea", "is this bet viable", "riskiest assumptions", "one-page business logic", part of The Complete Claude Guide for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
